operating_margin.basis: Operating income 331,637,000 SGD divided by revenue 441,362,000 SGD, both period ended 2025-12-31, from yfinance-statements statements in AJBU-SI.json. A high margin is typical of a listed data-center REIT's rental-income model.

fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 262,829,000 SGD less capital expenditure 38,923,000 SGD, divided by revenue 441,362,000 SGD, all period ended 2025-12-31.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 2,038,372,000 SGD (total debt 2,390,241,000 less cash 351,869,000, both period ended 2025-12-31) divided by an EBITDA proxy of operating income 331,637,000 SGD alone (the only depreciation point on file is dated 2021-12-31, not concurrent, so no D&A add-back is applied).
